lia: Heads up — saw a p99 spike on prod for the seqlen-512 generation workload after yesterday's capture-change rollout. Traces point to a kernel pick flipping mid-request and a KV-replay surge. cc @omar @ben

omar: Which rollout/commit? can you attach the profiler snippet?

lia: Rollout is infra/runtime-capture@abc123 (yesterday 22:10 UTC). Quick profiler summary below, full link: https://internal.gists/repro/2112345678 :eyes:

```
nsys summary (canary vs baseline):
- baseline: p99=210ms, avg=85ms
- canary:   p99=420ms, avg=130ms
- observed: kernel_A (optimized small-seq) 65% -> kernel_B (fallback-prefetch) 50% mid-request
- KV cache replay spikes: +3x kv-reads on continuation steps
- capture metadata: torch.compile=True, cuda_graphs_enabled=True, seq_bucket=512
```

ben: Is this reproducible locally with a short harness? suspect handoff between captured graph and dynamic tailing.

lia: Yes, small harness reproduces ~95th percentile. If I disable torch.compile the regression disappears. If I disable cuda_graph capture, also disappears.

maria: Sounds like the graph-capture handoff is triggering the kernel selector to switch to a prefetchy kernel path when it shouldn't. Autotuner might have recorded the wrong reward for the captured shape.

kevin: Quick mitigation — set LRT_PREFETCH_POLICY=off or LRT_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=stable_small_seq for that model in routing config, and canary it. Any perf tradeoff?

lia: Tried LRT_PREFETCH_POLICY=off on a small canary, p99 went down to ~225ms (near baseline). Will keep the canary running 30m.

omar: Long term we need kernel-selector to be capture-aware: consider (torch.compile, cuda_graph_active, kv_cache_mode, seqlen_bucket) tuple when selecting kernel and when reading autotune stats. We should also expire autotune observations collected under different capture flags.

ben: Agree. Also add metrics to the selector to log when a mid-request swap happens (old_kernel -> new_kernel) and a compact trace id so we can correlate nvprof/trace.

lia: Filed issue: ENG-RT-4591 with reproducer, profile link, and canary results. I'll open a followup PR to: 1) temporary revert prefetch default for seq512, 2) add capture-flag guard in selector, 3) add selector swap telemetry.

infra-bot: deploy-canary: canary rollout (infra/runtime-capture@abc123) paused at 3%. Reason: increased p99 on model x-prod.

kevin: Also check the KV cache replay logic — there was a recent change to prefetch KV pages during capture handoff that may double-read when the capture path falls back. Could be double-read triggering kernel switch due to different occupancy.

maria: Suggestion: when torch.compile or cuda_graphs_enabled, prefer conservative kernel choices until N warmup tokens/steps have seen stable kv_hit_rate > 0.9. That prevents optimistic prefetch triggering during handoff.

lia: Notes appended to ENG-RT-4591. Action items:
- lia: finish canary & revert prefetch default if stable (ETA 2h)
- ben: add selector telemetry and mid-request-swap counter (PR by tomorrow)
- omar: bisect autotuner writes around infra/runtime-capture@* (start now)
- kevin: audit KV prefetch double-read change (PR link in issue)

lia: Thanks all — tagging followups in the issue. If anyone wants the reproducible harness ping me and I'll share the docker image. :thumbsup:
